user.title: Add Apple TV or HomePod
user.description: Enter the IP address of the device, or leave it empty to search the network.

confirm.title: Add {name}?
confirm.description: Found **{name}** ({model}). Continue to pair it with Home Assistant.

password.title: AirPlay password
password.description: {protocol} on this device is password protected.

pair.title: Pair {protocol}
pair.description:
Enter the PIN that **{name}** is showing now for **{protocol}**.

Optional step: {optional}. Leave the PIN empty to skip an optional step (some features, such as playing URLs or power control, may then be missing).

pair_no_pin.title: Pair {protocol}
pair_no_pin.description: Enter the PIN **{pin}** on **{name}**, then press Submit.

error.cannot_connect: No Apple TV or HomePod answered at this address.
error.no_devices_found: No Apple TV or HomePod found on the network. Try entering its IP address.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN was wrong. A new PIN is now shown on the device.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. A new PIN is now shown on the device; try again.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.
abort.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Make sure the device is awake and "Allow access" for AirPlay is set to "Everyone on the same network" or "Anyone".

data_description.video_compat: How to handle videos the Apple TV can't play directly (MKV, WebM, AVI, VP9, DTS ...).
data_description.image_duration: How long an image stays on screen when sent to the Apple TV.
data_description.start_timeout: Seconds play_media waits so it can report startup errors. Playback continues in the background either way.

options.direct: Direct: always send the original URL
